# MedASR

Google · released 2025-12 · 0.105B params · health-ai-developer-foundations

**score -12.4** ±3.8 · #160 of 160 · from 2 benchmark results across 1 source · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

Score within the [Open ASR English short-form WER (March 2026)](https://whatmodel.sh/stt?set=open-asr-wer&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                  test                        score   implies  date        weight
<a name="speech-stt-transcribecpp-mit"></a>transcribe.cpp model …  <a href="https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/blob/18947cf405f957195dd457db4e34c1cff9e88889/catalog/medasr.json">LibriSpeech test-clean WER</a>  17.9%    -15.9   2026-09-15   68% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
                        <a href="https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp/blob/18947cf405f957195dd457db4e34c1cff9e88889/catalog/medasr.json">FLEURS English test WER</a>     37.5%    -16.4   2026-09-15   26% ▇▇▇
prior                   pull toward the middle                49.8                 6% ▇
                        weighted average                   = -12.4
</pre>

## How to run it

<pre>
version                       needs  score
q8_0-gguf (transcribe.cpp)  ~0.13GB  -12.4
</pre>

```sh
# q8_0-gguf (transcribe.cpp)
git clone https://github.com/handy-computer/transcribe.cpp.git && cd transcribe.cpp && cmake -B build && cmake --build build && hf download handy-computer/medasr-gguf medasr-Q8_0.gguf --local-dir models/medasr && build/bin/transcribe-cli --language en -m models/medasr/medasr-Q8_0.gguf audio.wav
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
